notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.5
notes.content:
🐞 Bug Fixes:

+Fixed a crash issue that occurred when navigating the options menu using a controller.

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.4
notes.content:
🐞 Bug Fixes:

+Fixed an issue in Level 21 that allowed players to complete the level without collecting the key.

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.3
notes.content:
🛠️ Improvements:

+Added a Discord community button to the main menu so you can easily join and connect with other players!

🐞 Bug Fixes:

+Fixed a glitch that allowed players to walk through walls in the secret level.

notes.title: HotFix
notes.content:
⚙️ Optimization:

+Improved performance across several levels to ensure smoother gameplay on a wider range of machines.

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.2
notes.content:
🛠️ Improvements:

+Added a second chance mechanic: when the player gets hit, they now have a brief moment of recovery instead of dying instantly.

notes.title: Hotfix – V1.0.1
notes.content:
🐞 Bug Fixes:

+Fixed the door issue in Level 21 that could block player progression.

🛠️ Improvements:

+Reworked Level 11 to avoid visual issues caused by ocean currents, making movement clearer and easier to follow.

notes.title: AquaDream New Trailer & Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled to finally share some exciting news with you all — the new AquaDream trailer is here, and we’ve also locked in our official release date! Get ready to dive deeper into the underwater world of AquaDream, because the game will be launching on May 22th, 2025!

It’s been an incredible journey bringing AquaDream to life, and we want to thank each and every one of you for your support, feedback, and patience throughout development. The game has evolved a lot since the early demo, and we’re so proud of how it’s shaping up. From the gameplay mechanics to the visuals and story, everything has been refined and enhanced based on your valuable input.

What’s New
The new trailer highlights the improvements and enhancements we’ve made since the first preview, showcasing:


 Refined visuals that bring the underwater environments to life with greater detail, from lush coral reefs to eerie, ancient ruins.

 Polished gameplay mechanics that make puzzle-solving and exploration feel smoother and more immersive.


[previewyoutube=vjameuQZ328;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank You for Your Support!
We’re incredibly grateful for the community that’s built around AquaDream. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game into what it is today. Whether you’ve been following us since the early days or just recently joined us, we want you to know how much your enthusiasm and support mean to us.

What’s Next?
As we countdown to May 22th, we’ll be sharing more updates, behind-the-scenes looks at development, and some exciting previews. Make sure to wishlist AquaDream on Steam to get notifications about the release, and don’t forget to follow us on social media for the latest news!

Price & Discounts:
We’re also excited to announce the pricing details for AquaDream’s launch:

AquaDream will be available for $4.99 USD at launch, with a 15% off discount for the first 14 days.

The Original Soundtrack (OST) will be available for $0.99 USD, also with a 15% off discount for the first 14 days.

There will be a bundle that includes both the game and the OST, which will be available at a 5% off discount for all time. During the first 14 days, the total discount for the bundle will be 20% off!

We hope these special offers make your experience with AquaDream even more exciting!

Once again, thank you so much for your support. AquaDream is closer than ever to being ready for release, and we can’t wait for you to experience the full journey!

See you underwater on May 22th, 2025!

Gossiam Games
